breaking.change: CPU ropes use explicit-velocity small-step XPBD. New stiffness (default 100000 N/m), mass (default 0.1 kg per point), substeps (default 4), coupling and breakForce fields control compliance, point mass, stepping, two-way rigid attachment/contact impulses and persistent overload breaks. Length edits reel the existing rope instead of rebuilding it; end accepts any Transform.
breaking.fix: Choose physical stiffness and point mass, enable coupling to transfer loads to dynamic endpoints and colliders, and set breakForce when breakage is wanted. Zero stiffness, substeps, coupling and breakForce disable their respective behaviors. Recreate old simulation state.

breaking.change: CPU cloth replaces Verlet/PBD with explicit velocities, area-lumped masses and XPBD. Stiffness is now physical N/m (default 100000); new bending, tether, density (default 1 kg/m²), drag and lift fields control dihedral bending, unilateral long-range attachments and aerodynamics. Wind is air velocity in m/s, not acceleration. Thickness enables vertex-triangle and edge-edge self-contact without the old speed cap; solids exchange momentum.
breaking.fix: Retune stiffness in physical units. Set nonzero drag/lift to make wind act, bending/tether to enable those constraints, and density to set surface mass (zero fixes free points). Choose substeps for contact resolution; zero substeps pauses simulation.

breaking.change: CPU garments use area-lumped explicit-velocity XPBD with physical stiffness (default 100000) and dihedral bending. New density (default 1), drag, lift, bodyRadius, backstopRadius and teleportDistance fields replace planar backstop and index-hashed wind behavior. MaxDistance/backstop scale with the character; wind is air velocity in m/s. Solid and body contacts remove inward relative velocity instead of accumulating gravity.
breaking.fix: Retune physical stiffness/bending and set drag/lift for wind. Set backstopRadius for spherical backstops and backstop for their offset, bodyRadius for posed skeleton capsules, and teleportDistance for pose-jump resets; zero disables each optional mechanism. Recreate old garment state.

breaking.change: CPU soft bodies use explicit-velocity XPBD, area-lumped masses, centroid-relative signed volume and gradients, and two-way solid contacts. Stiffness and volumeStiffness are physical coefficients (both default 100000); new density (default 1 kg/m²) and tetraStiffness enable surface mass and per-centroid-fan hydrostatic Neo-Hookean volume constraints. Registered mesh content revisions rebuild the shape on hot reload.
breaking.fix: Retune the physical edge/volume stiffness, set density for mass and tetraStiffness when local tetrahedral volume preservation is needed (zero disables it). The tetrahedral fan uses the surface centroid as a virtual interior vertex. Recreate old soft-body state.

breaking.change: PBF replaces DDR. New solverIterations (default 3, zero disables pressure passes) and vorticity (default zero/off) control density projection and confinement. Stiffness is the density relaxation fraction [0,1] (default 1); nearStiffness is the dimensionless s_corr coefficient (default 0.001); restDensity is the unnormalised poly6 count including self, multiplied by interpolated material density to obtain target mass density (default 2, zero disables pressure). Viscosity is stable mass-conserving XSPH. Count zero produces no particles; size edits rebuild the lattice. Mixed properties interpolate by composition; contacts push dynamic bodies.
breaking.fix: Retune density/stiffness/artificial pressure for PBF instead of DDR and set solverIterations/substeps for convergence. Use vorticity only when confinement is wanted. Recreate old fluid state.

breaking.change: CPU fluids use the same PBF, symmetric pressure, XSPH, mixed-material and two-way contact contract as Fluid2D, with solverIterations default 3, vorticity default 0, stiffness default 1, nearStiffness default 0.001 and restDensity default 2. Reflected radius now agrees with the Rust default, 0.2 m. Size edits rebuild the lattice and lowering maxCount truncates particles in order even when emission is disabled; maxCount zero empties the fluid.
breaking.fix: Retune the CPU material for PBF and recreate old fluid state. Use solverIterations zero to turn off density passes, vorticity zero for no confinement, and explicit maxCount for the particle budget. Visual GPU simulation is a separate solver.

breaking.change: EmitOffset, emitVelocity, the emitter cube, sinkOffset and the sink box now use entity-local axes and rotate with the entity. Emission rejects overlapping spawn candidates rather than fusing zero-distance particles.
breaking.fix: Express emitter offsets/velocities and sink boxes in local coordinates. A point emitter can defer drops while its previous drop still occupies the nozzle.

breaking.change: Triangle mesh colliders bake with ORIENTED pseudo-normals for point-solid inside classification, including reflected winding under negative scale. The triangle-mesh bake header is now OGTM version 2; old bakes are rejected.
breaking.fix: Recook triangle mesh assets and use consistently outward-wound closed meshes for solid interiors.

breaking.change: CPU soft and particle-fluid integration samples ForceField and WindMotor at every point, and the physics block stores the new XPBD/PBF state layout instead of Verlet/DDR state. Deferred reaction impulses update rigid velocities and wake events in the same tick.
breaking.fix: Recreate snapshots/replays from this engine version; old physics saves are not supported. Recheck spatial wind and force tuning because midpoint-only sampling is gone.

breaking.change: The Rust host pose contract adds world-space capsules: Vec<GarmentCapsule>, with endpoints a/b and endpoint radii radius_a/radius_b for tapered body contacts. The runtime supplies posed skeleton capsules when Garment.bodyRadius is nonzero.
breaking.fix: Host pose constructors must supply capsules (an empty vector disables body capsules), in canonical skeleton order and with radii already scaled into world metres.
